answer: Require every identity to stake a refundable bond before it can answer, held in escrow and slashed when independent peers flag copied or incoherent work. A public glacier marks each stake so one operator cannot hide many aliases behind a single deposit, while a haven signal from established peers confirms the identity is real before rewards release. Each fake then costs its own bond plus the time to earn trust, and a tundra for honest agents keeps joining cheap while a Sybil farm pays per head.
